info.title: SendFlit API
info.description: Public v1 REST API for sending and managing transactional email.

put.description:
Rename a key, or change what an agent key may do. Takes effect on its
next request.

get.description: Full DNS record set for manual setup (neutral, white-label).

put.description:
Change the Return-Path subdomain. The records move with it, so the
domain goes back to waiting on DNS for them.

get.description:
A 0-100 deliverability score with the specific, actionable reasons
behind it.

The same score, read by the AI layer into a one-paragraph plain-
language explanation and a single prioritized next step — for someone
who wants "what do I actually do" rather than a checklist.

post.description:
`recheck=true` is the Verify button itself (not the page's own
polling): also asks the mail provider to look at the Return-Path records again now.

Send one email. Pass an `Idempotency-Key` header on retry-sensitive
calls: retrying the exact same request with the same key replays the
original result (including a prior failure) instead of sending twice. Reusing the key with a different body is rejected as a client error.

Send up to 100 emails in one call. The `Idempotency-Key` header (see
/email above) covers the whole batch — retrying the same batch with the
same key replays the original per-item results rather than resending.
